name: connectors
source: PDTB 2.0 Annotation Manual (Prasad, Dinesh, Lee, Miltsakaki, Robaldo, Joshi & Webber, 2007; University of Pennsylvania), Appendix A - explicit connectives (selected subset, one primary sense class per entry). https://www.seas.upenn.edu/~pdtb/PDTBAPI/pdtb-annotation-manual.pdf

change.reason: precision: bare single-word connectives could not be disambiguated lexically, so the causal component was effectively a frequency count of 'as'

notes: Release 1.1 curation policy: the bare single-word connectives still, while, whilst, yet (contrastive), as, since, through (causal) and so, as such (result) were REMOVED because their temporal / degree / spatial / prepositional senses dominate in research prose and they cannot be disambiguated lexically (measured on the 36-paper VRP-GPU corpus: bare 'as' alone produced 73.5% of the causal component, almost all of it 'such as' / 'as shown' / 'as well as'). Every multiword PDTB explicit variant (as a result of, as a consequence of, as a result, as a consequence, so that, because of, due to, owing to, ...) is retained and matched longest-first, non-overlapping. Only entries whose primary reading is the connectives sense remain, so the density is interpretable as explicit-connective density, not word frequency.
